title: Generalized Extended Codes with Applications in Entanglement-Assisted Qubit and Qutrit Codes
summary: We prove that any generalized extended code is monomially equivalent to the Hermitian dual of a code which is closely related to a second kind of extended code of $\C^{\perp_{\rm H}}$. Every $[n+1,k+1]_{q^2}$ linear code $\D$ with $d(\D^{\perp_{\rm H}})>1$ is monomially equivalent to the generalized extended code $\C({\bf u},a)$ of an $[n,k]_{q^2}$ linear code $\C$ for a fixed $a\in\F_{q^2}^{*}$ and some ${\bf u}\in\F_{q^2}^{n}$.
